sentences.english: Good morning, Sam.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: Have you eaten anything yet?
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: Not yet, Ana.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: I have only just got up.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Doña Marta ha hecho frijoles y tortillas, y hay café en la mesa.
sentences.english: Doña Marta has made beans and tortillas, and there is coffee on the table.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: Thanks.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Pero primero tengo que buscar mi llave.
sentences.english: But first I have to look for my key.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Have you seen it?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: No, I haven't seen it.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: Where have you put it?
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: I don't know.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Ayer la tenía en la bolsa, pero ahora no hay nada en la bolsa.
sentences.english: Yesterday I had it in my bag, but now there is nothing in the bag.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: What is going on, children?
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: ¿Por qué todos hablan a la vez?
sentences.english: Why is everybody talking at once?
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Sam ha perdido su llave, doña Marta.
sentences.english: Sam has lost his key, doña Marta.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: Has anybody seen it?
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: Not I, dear.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.english: Poor Sam.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.english: Have you already looked in your room?
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.english: Not yet.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: First I wanted to have a coffee.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Will you accept a coffee?
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Tomá el café y comé un poco.
sentences.english: Have your coffee and eat a little.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.english: Afterwards we'll look again.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.english: I accept, doña Marta.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: You are always right.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Abuela, yo no he visto nada.
sentences.english: Grandmother, I haven't seen anything.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Can I help?
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Yes, Nico.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Preguntá a tu tío Luis si ha visto la llave.
sentences.english: Ask your uncle Luis whether he has seen the key.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Yo tampoco la he visto, Nico.
sentences.english: I haven't seen it either, Nico.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: Ninguno de nosotros la ha visto.
sentences.english: None of us has seen it.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: Pero casi siempre la dejás en la bolsa, Sam, ¿verdad?
sentences.english: But you almost always leave it in your bag, Sam, don't you?
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.english: Yes, almost always.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Jamás he perdido una llave en mi vida.
sentences.english: I have never lost a key in my life.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Jamás he conocido a nadie que no pierda algo, hijo.
sentences.english: I have never met anybody who doesn't lose something, son.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Todos perdemos una llave alguna vez.
sentences.english: We all lose a key sometime.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Bueno, hay que intentar otra vez.
sentences.english: Well, we must try again.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Vamos a buscar en tu cuarto.
sentences.english: Let's look in your room.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Sam, Ana y Nico entran en el cuarto.
sentences.english: Sam, Ana and Nico go into the room.

sentences.text: La cama está sin hacer, porque Sam apenas se ha levantado.
sentences.english: The bed is unmade, because Sam has only just got up.
There is nothing here, Sam.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.text: ¿Has buscado en el pantalón de ayer?
sentences.english: Have you looked in yesterday's trousers?
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: No.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Aún no he mirado el pantalón.
sentences.english: I haven't looked at the trousers yet.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Just a moment...
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Here it is!
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: La llave estaba en el pantalón.
sentences.english: The key was in the trousers.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: You see?
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Cuando buscamos con paz, alguien siempre descubre algo.
sentences.english: When we search in peace, somebody always discovers something.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: I made a mistake, Ana.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Creía que la llave estaba en la bolsa, pero no era verdad.
sentences.english: I thought the key was in the bag, but it wasn't true.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Sam, ¿has notado que el pantalón tiene una bolsa grande?
sentences.english: Sam, have you noticed that the trousers have a big pocket?
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: There you put the key.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: That's true, Nico.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: We have already solved the problem.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Thanks to you both.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: I discovered the key, didn't I?
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.english: Then I want a banana.
sentences.speaker: N

sentences.text: He notado que siempre pedís un plátano cuando ayudás.
sentences.english: I have noticed that you always ask for a banana when you help.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: But that's fine.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: You're welcome.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: Now, let's eat.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Doña Marta no ha comido todavía y nos espera.
sentences.english: Doña Marta hasn't eaten yet and is waiting for us.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Después del desayuno, Luis llega con un amigo.
sentences.english: After breakfast, Luis arrives with a friend.

sentences.text: El amigo es salvadoreño y se llama Daniel.
sentences.english: The friend is Salvadoran and is called Daniel.

sentences.text: Hoy ha venido a Honduras por primera vez y quiere conocer el país.
sentences.english: Today he has come to Honduras for the first time and wants to get to know the country.

sentences.text: Luis ha mencionado a Daniel muchas veces en casa, pero nadie lo conoce.
sentences.english: Luis has mentioned Daniel several times at home, but nobody knows him.

sentences.text: Apenas ha llegado, y ya quiere intentar hablar como los hondureños.
sentences.english: He has only just arrived, and he already wants to try to speak like the Hondurans.

sentences.text: Daniel, ¿has estado alguna vez en Honduras?
sentences.english: Daniel, have you ever been in Honduras?
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: No, jamás he venido por aquí.
sentences.english: No, I have never come this way.
sentences.speaker: D

sentences.english: I only know the border.
sentences.speaker: D

sentences.english: Then you have a lot to see.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: Honduras es una nación de Centroamérica, como tu país.
sentences.english: Honduras is a nation in Central America, just like your country.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.english: Yes, we are two Central American nations.
sentences.speaker: D

sentences.text: He notado que aquí todos saludan a todos, y he descubierto que me gusta.
sentences.english: I have noticed that here everybody greets everybody, and I have discovered that I like it.
sentences.speaker: D

sentences.text: Pero aún no sé nada del norte, y mi hermano tampoco.
sentences.english: But I still know nothing about the north, and my brother doesn't either.
sentences.speaker: D

sentences.text: En el norte hay una costa muy bonita.
sentences.english: In the north there is a very pretty coast.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.english: And there are islands, too.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.english: And in the south?
sentences.speaker: D

sentences.english: Are there valleys and forests?
sentences.speaker: D

sentences.english: Yes.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: En el sur hace más calor.
sentences.english: In the south it is hotter.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: La temperatura sube mucho en verano.
sentences.english: The temperature rises a lot in summer.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: He oído que hay un lago grande.
sentences.english: I have heard there is a big lake.
sentences.speaker: D

sentences.english: Has any of you seen it?
sentences.speaker: D

sentences.english: I have.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Lo he visto con mi familia.
sentences.english: I have seen it with my family.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Allí hay aves y hasta monos en el bosque.
sentences.english: There are birds there and even monkeys in the forest.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: Monkeys!
sentences.speaker: D

sentences.text: Yo nunca he visto un mono de cerca.
sentences.english: I have never seen a monkey up close.
sentences.speaker: D

sentences.english: I want to see one soon.
sentences.speaker: D

sentences.english: Come with us on Saturday.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.english: We have thought of going to the lake.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.english: Thank you, I accept gladly.
sentences.speaker: D

sentences.text: No dudo que va a ser un día muy bueno.
sentences.english: I don't doubt it is going to be a very good day.
sentences.speaker: D

sentences.english: I don't doubt it either.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Pero nadie ha mirado la hora todavía.
sentences.english: But nobody has looked at the time yet.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: At what time do we leave?
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Ninguno de nosotros quiere llegar tarde.
sentences.english: None of us wants to arrive late.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.english: We leave at six.
sentences.speaker: L

sentences.text: Por la tarde, doña Marta y Ana hablan en la mesa.
sentences.english: In the afternoon, doña Marta and Ana talk at the table.
Ana, have you spoken with the doctor?
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.english: Yes, doña Marta.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Al comienzo de la semana nadie me dijo nada, pero hoy el doctor me ha mencionado una buena cosa.
sentences.english: At the start of the week nobody told me anything, but today the doctor has mentioned a good thing to me.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: What has he told you?
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Ha obtenido más pastillas para el pueblo.
sentences.english: He has obtained more pills for the village.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Hay que continuar con el trabajo, dice.
sentences.english: We must continue with the work, he says.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: And who has paid for them?
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.english: A church in another city.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: El doctor ha obtenido el dinero con una carta.
sentences.english: The doctor obtained the money with a letter.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Ninguno de los vecinos ha dudado de ese doctor.
sentences.english: None of the neighbours has doubted that doctor.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.english: He is a good man.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.english: It's true.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Al inicio del año yo quería cambiar de trabajo, pero ahora voy a continuar.
sentences.english: At the beginning of the year I wanted to change jobs, but now I am going to continue.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Desde el comienzo he aprendido mucho.
sentences.english: Since the start I have learned a lot.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: How good.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.english: Nobody helps like you.
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.text: Esa noche, Sam escribe una carta.
sentences.english: That night Sam writes a letter.

sentences.text: Está en su cuarto, con la mesa y una taza de café.
sentences.english: He is in his room, with the table and a cup of coffee.

sentences.text: Escribe con cuidado, porque aún no quiere equivocarse en español.
sentences.english: He writes carefully, because he doesn't want to make mistakes in Spanish yet.
Dear Sofía,
I miss you a lot.

sentences.text: Todavía no he recibido tu carta, pero sé que vas a escribir pronto.
sentences.english: I haven't received your letter yet, but I know you will write soon.

sentences.text: Hoy ha sido un día difícil.
sentences.english: Today has been a difficult day.

sentences.text: Primero perdí mi llave, y después la encontré en el pantalón.
sentences.english: First I lost my key, and then I found it in my trousers.

sentences.text: Resolví el problema con la ayuda de Nico.
sentences.english: I solved the problem with Nico's help.

sentences.text: Él me ha dicho que casi todos los días alguien pierde algo en esta casa.
sentences.english: He told me that almost every day somebody loses something in this house.

sentences.text: Ya he vuelto a trabajar con el equipo, y esta semana he conocido a muchas personas.
sentences.english: I have already gone back to working with the team, and this week I have met many people.

sentences.text: Algunos hablan mucho y yo entiendo poco.
sentences.english: Some talk a lot and I understand little.

sentences.text: Les pido que repitan las palabras, y todos me ayudan.
sentences.english: I ask them to repeat the words, and everyone helps me.

sentences.text: He intentado hablar solo en español durante dos días.
sentences.english: I have tried to speak only Spanish for two days.

sentences.text: Todavía no comprendo todo, pero ya entiendo más que antes.
sentences.english: I don't understand everything yet, but I already understand more than before.
I am going to continue like this.

sentences.text: Al inicio de la semana no entendía nada, y jamás he trabajado así con un idioma.
sentences.english: At the start of the week I understood nothing, and I have never worked like this on a language.

sentences.text: Un abrazo y mucho cariño para mamá y papá.
sentences.english: A hug and lots of love for Mom and Dad.
Your brother, Sam

sentences.text: Al otro día, Ana llega a la casa con una noticia.
sentences.english: The next day, Ana comes to the house with some news.

sentences.text: Sam, mi amiga Karla ha obtenido un cuarto cerca de la clínica y lo ha alquilado.
sentences.english: Sam, my friend Karla has got a room near the clinic and has rented it.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Dice que desde el comienzo del mes hay lugar para otra persona.
sentences.english: She says that since the start of the month there is room for another person.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: That way we solve your problem.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: What is the price?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Desde el inicio quiero pagar poco, porque no tengo mucho dinero todavía.
sentences.english: From the start I want to pay little, because I don't have much money yet.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: I don't know.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Ella no me ha mencionado el valor.
sentences.english: She hasn't mentioned the price to me.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Pero yo no creo que sea caro.
sentences.english: But I don't think it is expensive.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: Where do I have to go?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Here, or over there, near the market?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Over there, near the market.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text: Corré a buscar tu bolsa y vamos ahora.
sentences.english: Run and get your bag and we'll go now.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: One moment.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: What about the key?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.english: Where have I put it?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Sam, la llave la tenés en la mano.
sentences.english: Sam, you have the key in your hand.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.english: I've made a mistake again.
sentences.speaker: S
